title: Applied AI Engineer Advancement roadmap
summary: A step-by-step plan to deepen LLM expertise, build showcase projects, and prepare for senior-level roles. Focuses on advanced techniques, leadership habits, and interview readiness.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Refresh core programming and AI fundamentals.

milestones.title: Choose Python or TypeScript
milestones.outcome: Write clean, production-ready code in Python or TypeScript.

tasks.title: Complete Python basics on freeCodeCamp
tasks.description: Finish the introductory Python module, focusing on data structures and functions.

tasks.title: Build a CLI utility for file stats
tasks.description: Create a command-line tool that reports size, line count, and word frequency of a text file.

tasks.title: Refactor utility with type hints
tasks.description: Add static typing and run mypy to ensure type safety.

tasks.title: Review TypeScript docs on modules
tasks.description: Read the official TypeScript module documentation on the Microsoft site and note key import/export patterns.

tasks.title: Connect with a Python community
tasks.description: Join a Python Discord or subreddit and introduce yourself, asking for feedback on your utility project.

milestones.title: LLM API fundamentals
milestones.outcome: Call major LLM services and handle responses programmatically.

tasks.title: Read OpenAI API quickstart guide
tasks.description: Study the official OpenAI quickstart page and understand authentication and request format.

tasks.title: Build a simple text-completion script
tasks.description: Write a Python script that sends a prompt to the OpenAI Completion endpoint and prints the result.

tasks.title: Practice error handling for rate limits
tasks.description: Add retry logic and exponential back-off to your script for HTTP 429 responses.

tasks.title: Compare Anthropic and Cohere docs
tasks.description: Skim the public API reference pages for Anthropic and Cohere, noting differences in payload structure.

tasks.title: Reflect on API cost considerations
tasks.description: Write a short note on token pricing and strategies to minimize usage in production.

phases.title: Core skills
phases.summary: Develop prompt engineering, retrieval, and evaluation capabilities.

milestones.title: Learn prompt design
milestones.outcome: Craft effective prompts that reliably guide LLM behavior.

tasks.title: Study prompt design guide on OpenAI docs
tasks.description: Read the official guide, focusing on system messages, few-shot examples, and temperature control.

tasks.title: Create a prompt template library
tasks.description: Implement reusable Jinja2 templates for common patterns like classification and extraction.

tasks.title: Practice iterative prompt tuning
tasks.description: Run A/B tests on two variations of a prompt and record quality metrics.

tasks.title: Connect with prompt-engineering community
tasks.description: Attend a free webinar or Discord AMA on prompt design and ask a question about your template library.

tasks.title: Reflect on failure cases
tasks.description: Document three prompts that performed poorly and hypothesize why.

milestones.title: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
milestones.outcome: Integrate external knowledge sources into LLM responses.

tasks.title: Read LangChain RAG tutorial on docs.langchain.com
tasks.description: Follow the step-by-step example that builds a vector store and queries it.

tasks.title: Build a simple vector store with FAISS
tasks.description: Index a small set of PDFs and write a query function that returns top-k chunks.

tasks.title: Practice prompt chaining for retrieval
tasks.description: Combine a retrieval step with a generation prompt, measuring relevance of answers.

tasks.title: Explore Pinecone free tier docs
tasks.description: Read Pinecone’s getting-started guide and note API differences from FAISS.

tasks.title: Reflect on latency trade-offs
tasks.description: Write a brief analysis of in-memory vs. hosted vector stores for production use.

milestones.title: Evaluation techniques
milestones.outcome: Design and run systematic tests for LLM outputs.

tasks.title: Read evaluation section of the LLM evaluation handbook
tasks.description: Focus on human-in-the-loop and automated metrics like BLEU, ROUGE, and LLM-based scoring.

tasks.title: Build an evaluation harness for prompts
tasks.description: Create a Python framework that runs a set of prompts, captures responses, and computes chosen metrics.

tasks.title: Practice statistical analysis of results
tasks.description: Use pandas to calculate mean, variance, and confidence intervals for metric scores.

tasks.title: Connect with evaluation researchers on Twitter
tasks.description: Follow three experts and comment on a recent paper about LLM benchmarking.

tasks.title: Reflect on ethical implications
tasks.description: Write a short note on bias detection and mitigation in your evaluation pipeline.

phases.title: Proof of work
phases.summary: Create portfolio projects that showcase end-to-end AI products.

milestones.title: Document Q&A app with citations
milestones.outcome: Deploy a web app that answers user questions using RAG and returns source references.

tasks.title: Design data ingestion pipeline
tasks.description: Write a script that extracts text from PDFs, splits into chunks, and stores embeddings in Pinecone.

tasks.title: Implement backend API with FastAPI
tasks.description: Create endpoints for query, retrieval, and generation, returning citations in JSON.

tasks.title: Build frontend UI with React
tasks.description: Develop a simple React page where users type questions and see highlighted answers with source links.

tasks.title: Practice end-to-end testing
tasks.description: Write integration tests that simulate a user query and verify citation format.

tasks.title: Reflect on UX improvements
tasks.description: Record three UI tweaks that could make citations clearer for users.

milestones.title: Tool-using AI agent
milestones.outcome: Deliver an autonomous agent that can call external APIs (e.g., weather, calendar) to accomplish tasks.

tasks.title: Study LangChain agents guide
tasks.description: Read the official LangChain documentation on tool-using agents and their configuration.

tasks.title: Build a weather-lookup tool wrapper
tasks.description: Create a Python function that calls a free weather API and returns structured data.

tasks.title: Integrate tool into an agent chain
tasks.description: Configure a LangChain agent to invoke the weather tool based on user intent.

tasks.title: Practice multi-step planning
tasks.description: Test the agent on a scenario requiring scheduling and weather info, refining prompts as needed.

tasks.title: Connect with AI-agent community on Reddit
tasks.description: Post a demo video and ask for feedback on tool integration.

milestones.title: Evaluation harness for prompts
milestones.outcome: Provide a reusable framework that benchmarks prompts across multiple LLM providers.

tasks.title: Define benchmark dataset
tasks.description: Select 20 diverse test cases (question, expected answer) from public datasets like SQuAD.

tasks.title: Implement multi-provider runner
tasks.description: Write code that sends each prompt to OpenAI, Anthropic, and Cohere, collecting responses.

tasks.title: Practice result visualization
tasks.description: Use matplotlib or Plotly to plot metric comparisons across providers.

tasks.title: Reflect on cross-provider consistency
tasks.description: Write a brief analysis of where models diverge and why.

tasks.title: Connect with hiring managers on LinkedIn
tasks.description: Share the repo link and ask for thoughts on its usefulness for interview prep.

phases.title: Getting ready
phases.summary: Polish leadership, advanced topics, and senior-level interview preparation.

milestones.title: Advanced system design for AI products
milestones.outcome: Architect scalable, secure AI services ready for production.

tasks.title: Read Google Cloud architecture Center on AI pipelines
tasks.description: Focus on sections about model serving, autoscaling, and monitoring.

tasks.title: Design a microservice diagram for an LLM product
tasks.description: Create a UML diagram showing API gateway, inference service, vector store, and logging.

tasks.title: Practice cost-estimation calculations
tasks.description: Use pricing calculators to estimate monthly spend for compute and storage.

tasks.title: Connect with a senior AI engineer for mentorship
tasks.description: Schedule a 30-minute informational chat to discuss design trade-offs.

tasks.title: Reflect on reliability strategies
tasks.description: Write notes on fallback models, circuit breakers, and health checks.

milestones.title: Leadership and communication
milestones.outcome: Lead AI projects and convey technical decisions to stakeholders.

tasks.title: Read “The manager’s path” chapter on technical leadership
tasks.description: Summarize key habits for guiding engineers and managing AI initiatives.

tasks.title: Build a project charter template
tasks.description: Create a reusable document that outlines scope, milestones, risks, and success metrics for AI projects.

tasks.title: Practice presenting a demo to non-technical audience
tasks.description: Record a 5-minute video explaining your document Q&A app without jargon.

tasks.title: Connect with product managers on a community forum
tasks.description: Join a product-focused Slack channel and discuss AI feature prioritization.

tasks.title: Reflect on feedback received
tasks.description: Write a short improvement plan based on audience questions and suggestions.

milestones.title: Senior interview preparation
milestones.outcome: Confidently tackle system design, coding, and AI-focused interview questions.

tasks.title: Study system design primer on GitHub (free repo)
tasks.description: Read the sections on data pipelines and ML model serving.

tasks.title: Build a mock system design presentation
tasks.description: Create slides for a scalable RAG service and rehearse answering follow-up questions.

tasks.title: Practice whiteboard coding on LeetCode easy problems
tasks.description: Solve three Python coding challenges under a timed condition.

tasks.title: Connect with a mock interview platform
tasks.description: Schedule a free peer interview focused on AI product scenarios.

tasks.title: Reflect on interview performance
tasks.description: Write a post-mortem noting strengths, gaps, and next steps for improvement.
